veranderings.blok: 'n Vloeistof neem die houer se vorm aan
veranderings.voor: hoë, smal glas en dit staan
veranderings.na: hoë, smal glas, en dit staan
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: comma before 'en' joining two main clauses (an imperative clause and 'dit staan').

veranderings.blok: 'n Vloeistof neem die houer se vorm aan
veranderings.voor: vlak bak en dit lê breed
veranderings.na: vlak bak, en dit lê breed
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: comma before 'en' joining two main clauses, consistent with the rest of the lesson.

veranderings.voor: Draai hom nou skuins en groot
veranderings.na: Draai hom nou skuins, en groot
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: comma before 'en' joining two main clauses ('groot borrels kom' has its own subject and verb).

veranderings.voor: opgeblaas het tussen jou twee hande
veranderings.na: opgeblaas het, tussen jou twee hande
veranderings.rede: A comma after the embedded relative clause separates the clashing verb 'het' from the main clause, as the lesson already does in 'wat jy om jou sien, is'.

veranderings.voor: stoot terug teen jou twee hande
veranderings.na: stoot teen jou twee hande terug
veranderings.rede: The separable verb 'terugstoot' reads more naturally with its particle at the end of the clause.

veranderings.voor: Die water styg by die mond in
veranderings.na: Die water stroom by die mond in
veranderings.rede: 'styg ... in' is an unnatural verb combination; 'stroom by die mond in' is idiomatic and keeps the meaning of water entering the bottle.

veranderings.voor: daardie gas is net soos lug 'n gas
veranderings.na: daardie gas is, net soos lug, 'n gas
veranderings.rede: Commas set off the comparison so the clause does not read as 'lug 'n gas' run together.

veranderings.blok: Hoe jy die drie uitmekaar ken
veranderings.voor: Vra laastens of sy stil boonste kant plat lê
veranderings.na: Vra laastens of die materiaal se stil boonste kant plat lê
veranderings.rede: 'sy' here has no clear antecedent in the sentence and can be misread as 'she'; naming the material makes the reference clear and leaves 'stil boonste kant' intact.
